description_en: Queries the configurations of fine-grained monitoring in a region
description_zh: 查询指定地域的秒级监控配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-high-defination-monitor --tags tagKey_:_Key1_,_tagValue_:_Value1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHighDefinationMonitor

parameters.help_en: The tags of the logs. The tags must be key-value pairs that are contained in a JSON dictionary

parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where you want to query the configuration of fine-grained monitoring.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list

需要查询秒级监控信息的地域ID。
